Sequenced AHEAD of stoa--04n (workflow-composer skill promotion) per PRINCIPAL 2026-05-31.

FAILURE MODE (one line): verification anchored to ARTIFACT-CORRECTNESS ('does the built thing behave as built?') instead of THREAT-DEFEAT ('does it defeat the threat it was created to address?'). A build drifted to a plausible-but-wrong surface; 5 verify stages passed it (all checked 'does it work?', none 'does it defeat threat M2?'); caught only at the user-tier close-gate. SEVERITY: MAJOR-but-BOUNDED (DoS amplification, not breach); the value is the PROCESS fix.

CONVERGENCE with the 2026-05-30 workflow session: the KEYSTONE change (#5, threat-coverage assertion in verdict templates) IS the tier-iii schema-forced discipline-enforcement prototyped at stoa--aox. This incident is the real-world N=2 anchor for stoa--aox (discipline-enforcement), stoa--q36 (builds execute direction, never set it — the build silently picked the easier reading of an ambiguous ratification), and stoa--myd (thin multi-checker redundancy — only the last layer asked the threat question). Building it through the gauntlet doubles as the gauntlet-as-workflow battle-test + first real discipline-enforcement instantiation.

CHILDREN map the 7 u--ith changes onto our framework (lead with C1 = #5 keystone). EXECUTION: multi-concern (7 changes) -> external review before dispatch (MAJOR_POLYBIUS.md §5.4); substrate canon -> gauntlet/PLINY (§3, §18.2), not a POLYBIUS hand-build.

CROSS-REFS: u--ith, u--tgc (user-beadwork); stoa--aox, stoa--q36, stoa--myd; origindex-trw (the arc + floor-manager post-mortem).

EXTERNAL REVIEW (cold-Claude, independent fresh context, per §5.4). VERDICT: do NOT ship as one arc as-decomposed. Key findings:
- BLOCKER-1 (keystone inversion): #5 (verdict threat-coverage assertion) fixes the SYMPTOM; the root cause is direction-binding (#3 disambiguate ratification + #2 fold gate-item into design + #1 threat->mitigation map). The directive's OWN text annotates #2 'this was the root cause' yet keystones #5. Re-keystone to #3; prevention before detection. NOTE: this contradicts u--ith's stated emphasis (#5 = 'highest-leverage') -> surfaced to PRINCIPAL for adjudication per §4.3.
- BLOCKER-2 (dependency-order inversion): #5 asserts 'M defeats T via probe P' but T is produced by #1 and P by #4 — the decomposition ships the CONSUMER before the PRODUCERS. Reorder #3->#2->#1->#4->#5->#6->#7. (A keystone is the LAST stone, not the first.)
- MAJOR-1 (false-confidence, the Q3 trap): a mandatory threat-coverage LINE with no truth-anchor relocates 'works on paper' one layer up — a present-but-FALSE 'M defeats T' is MORE dangerous than an honest gap (the close-gate trusts the performed check). Fix: anchor #5's assertion to #4's EXECUTED attack-path probe (cited by id, output attached), not a free-text sentence. Make absence-of-executed-probe the finding, not absence-of-sentence (MINOR-1).
- MAJOR-2 (definitions gap): 'named threat' / 'threat-ratified mitigation' undefined; cheapest MUST-escape is arguing the trigger doesn't apply — the incident's gate-added item might not classify, so the fix could miss the very incident that motivated it. Add a definitions child; explicitly include gate-origin items; assign classification to an upstream owner (DAEDALUS/ARGUS) so it can't be self-exempted.
- MAJOR-3 (un-merge C4): #2 (structural) and #3 (interpretive) are different mechanisms with different failure modes; #3 is the actual root-cause fix. Split, separate acceptance, #3 gates #2.
- MAJOR-4 (self-reference): the arc hardens the gauntlet it runs through. Split into Arc A (prevention: #3/#2/#1) lands first, Arc B (detection: #4/#5/#6) built+verified by the already-hardened gauntlet. Carve hardening arcs out of 'threat-ratified' by definition.
- MAJOR-5 (N=1 over-fit + honest reframe): machinery is fitted to one shape (right-threat/wrong-surface) and misses adjacent modes (incomplete threat enumeration; probe necessary-not-sufficient; mitigation defeats T but regresses elsewhere). Reframe the claim: it verifies NAMED-threat coverage, not threat-defeat in general; threat-ENUMERATION completeness stays ARGUS's unmechanized residual risk — label it, don't overclaim.
- MINOR-2: #6 must be independent RE-DERIVATION, not a rubber-stamp of #5's line; #3's 'ambiguous' trigger is a soft predicate hiding a MAY in a MUST — make unconditional ('restate every ratification as threat+attack-path before build').
- NIT: 6->7 mapping complete (no drops); verify against real code — verdict-template Zod/gen-data implications, whether VERA probes are runner-executed, whether ARGUS already assigns threat IDs.
CONVERGENCE: the review's re-keystone-to-direction-binding is exactly stoa--q36 (builds execute direction, never set it); the false-confidence trap is the 'who checks the checker' risk from stoa--aox. Full review in the subagent transcript. Restructuring pending PRINCIPAL go.

RESTRUCTURE ACCEPTED (PRINCIPAL 2026-05-31, per external review). This supersedes the .1-.6 decomposition; authoritative spec is the Arc A directive at substrate/arcs/arc-52-threat-defeat-prevention-directive.md. SPLIT INTO TWO ARCS:

ARC A — PREVENTION (dispatch FIRST; the root-cause fixes):
- A1 (#3, new keystone): orchestrator MUST restate EVERY ratification as threat + attack-path before build — UNCONDITIONAL (no 'ambiguous' judgment trigger; that hid a MAY in a MUST).
- A2 (#2): gate-ratified items folded into the design WITH a threat->mitigation map BEFORE build, not appended as a build-scope bullet.
- A3 (#1): DAEDALUS threat->mitigation map for every threat-addressing mitigation; ARGUS flags a mapless mitigation as a design smell.
- A4 (definitions, was MAJOR-2): define 'named threat' (= ARGUS-surfaced OR gate-introduced — INCLUDE gate-origin) + 'threat-ratified mitigation'; assign classification to an upstream owner (DAEDALUS/ARGUS at design time); a security-relevant change with NO threat classification is itself a finding.

ARC B — DETECTION (AFTER Arc A lands + is verified by the Arc-A-hardened gauntlet):
- B1 (#4): threat-anchored probes (exercise the attack path + assert legit traffic unthrottled).
- B2 (#5): verdict threat-coverage assertion ANCHORED to B1's EXECUTED probe (cited by id, output attached); absence of an executed probe is the finding (not absence of a sentence).
- B3 (#6): floor-manager/close-gate INDEPENDENT RE-DERIVATION, not a rubber-stamp of B2's line.
- B4 (#7): culture/framing.

LOCKED (from review): prevention-before-detection; the hardening arcs themselves are carved OUT of 'threat-ratified' by definition (no self-reference); honest claim = NAMED-threat coverage, with threat-ENUMERATION completeness named as ARGUS's residual unmechanized risk (lands in Arc B framing). The old children .1-.6 are superseded — treat the Arc A/B structure above + the arc-52 directive as authoritative.

THE ADJUDICATION ASK (one interpretive/direction question; ARGUS root r1):

(b) FIRING BEAT (r2) = canonize the post-ARGUS / pre-ADA design-gate as a NAMED beat in PLINY SS5 (the beat this arc is literally operating right now). A1 fires at that beat: 'before dispatching ADA, restate every ratification'. Gives r1 a home + gives A1 a canon-anchored WHEN. NOTE: this lightly expands the PLINY SS5 surface (a new named gauntlet beat) — flagging because it is a substrate-shape change beyond the 4 stubs, so it needs your explicit OK.
(c) CARVE-OUT CHECKER (r3) = the self-reference carve-out classification ('process change, no runtime attack path') is CONFIRMED by ARGUS at critique time (ARGUS already owns A4 classification), not self-asserted by the building seat. Closes r3 with the existing ownership structure, no new seat.
(d) r5 (map-template drift) = byte-align the 3 inline copies; folds into the rev2.
